title: Building the First Mosque
paragraphs: Shortly after arriving in Madinah, the Prophet ﷺ was working alongside his companions to build a simple mosque, carrying stones and mud bricks with his own hands rather than merely directing others.
While other leaders of that era typically supervised construction from a distance, he was physically laboring side by side with everyone, an approach that surprised the newly forming community.
One companion later recalled that watching their leader working just as hard as anyone else made the whole community feel more united and equally invested in the mosque they were building together.
This simple building later became the center of the growing Muslim community, and the story of everyone building it together is still referenced today when discussing collective, shared effort.
